title: XYUV wire EDM: expose heal_tolerance in WireFourAxis, UI, MCP, and op status notes

body:
Expose `heal_tolerance` through the operation types, project DTO, UI, and MCP tools, and show wire uncut-corner notes in the op status banner.

## Context

`WireFourAxis` (`crates/app/src/operation/types/wire_edm.rs`), `WireFourAxisDto` (`crates/app/src/project/wire_edm_dto.rs`), `wire_ruled::digest` (`crates/app/src/operation/wire_ruled.rs`), and `wire_page.rs` (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/wire_page.rs`) carry `tolerance` and `verify_tolerance` (#1170), but have no `heal_tolerance` field. Also, `op_page::status_text` (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/op_page.rs`) currently forwards only notes matched by `approach_page::entry_status_lines`, so the GUI hides uncut-corner notes in `Toolpath::notes`.

## What this does

- Add `heal_tolerance: f64` (`0.0` default, finite and bounded in `WireFourAxis::is_sane`) to `WireFourAxis` and `WireFourAxisDto` (`skip_serializing_if = "is_zero"` so existing files stay unchanged).
- Include `heal_tolerance` in `wire_ruled::digest` so editing it marks the cached path stale, and pass it to `WireRuled`.
- Add the `heal_tolerance` control to `four_axis_fields` in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/wire_page.rs` with clear hint text.
- Ensure MCP `list_operation_types` and `edit_operation` (`crates/app/src/mcp/`) expose and validate `heal_tolerance` through `EditOperationParams`.
- Surface wire uncut-corner notes from `Toolpath::notes` in `op_page::status_text` (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/approach_page.rs` / `op_page.rs`).

## Done means:

- Project JSON round-trips `heal_tolerance` (`0.0` omitted), changing it invalidates the operation stamp, UI and MCP edit it undoably, and `op_page::status_text` shows healed uncut-corner notes.

Part of #2690
